suggestions.quote: Your cousin Aarav. Eleven. Talks about cricket every single day.
suggestions.fix: Make the first use causal: “So you test that rule on your cousin Aarav. Eleven. Cricket every single day.”

suggestions.quote: Zero point two. Against the family's money. And the biggest number is the right choice. Isn't it?
suggestions.fix: Tie the cost to the lesson you only half-learned: “Zero point two. Against the family's money. You can't borrow his odds. But you can still save him from them. Right?”

keep.quote: You can't borrow someone's odds. Only their apron.
But it's his. And it's moving.
